testcase.name: Scenario: Press Escape with a compact Options panel open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:483:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Press Escape with a compact Options panel open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons ✔ When the user clicks the Options panel button ✔ Then the Options commands appear in a temporary panel below the buttons ✔ And the Options panel button is highlighted ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the temporary Options panel remains visible ✔ And the Options panel button remains highlighted ✔ When the user clicks a face of the part outside the panel ✔ Then the temporary Options panel closes ✔ And the compact panel buttons remain visible
